# weir untrack

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

Stop mirroring an owner or repository; its mirrors stay on disk.

```text
Stop mirroring an owner or repository; its mirrors stay on disk

Usage: weir untrack [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          <host>/<owner> or <host>/<owner>/<repo>

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable output

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
